verdict.rationale: Retell's first-party docs describe webhooks that push real-time account events (call_started, call_ended, call_analyzed) to your own server, so integrations can react without polling. This is a genuine outbound HTTP callback that a programmatic consumer can receive. missing for 10: documented steps for registering a webhook URL and filtering events, signature verification and retry/delivery-guarantee details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow your application to receive real-time notifications about events that occur in your Retell AI account.
call_started, call_ended, and call_analyzed events delivered to your server so you can react to call activity without polling.
webhooks push data to your application as events happen, making your integrations more efficient and responsive.
